caseName: Volkswagenwerk Aktiengesellschaft v. Federal Maritime Commission
caseNameFull: Volkswagenwerk Aktiengesellschaft v. Federal Maritime Commission
attorneys: Cecelia H. Goetz and Richard Whiting on the motion. Solicitor General Griswold and Robert N. Katz for the Federal Maritime Commission et al., R. Frederic Fisher for Pacific Maritime Assn., and William W. Schwarzer for Marine Terminals Corp., in opposition.

opinions.text:
390 U. S. 261. Upon consideration of motion of petitioner to amend judgment and retax costs, the judgment heretofore issued in this case on April 1, 1968, is amended to tax one-half of the costs in favor of petitioner and against respondents Pacific Maritime Assn, and Marine Terminals Corp.

Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
